  • Judges 9:42–45 · ，就起来攻击他们 (recoverable from context) — The exact deletion leaves the complete, natural sentence “他看见百姓从城里出来。” It removes his rising up and attacking those people in response to seeing them. The following verse supplies related attack details, but that does not preserve the explicit action in the edited statement.
  • Judges 9:42–45 · 亚比米勒和跟随他的队伍向前冲去， (possible other meaning changed · recoverable from context) — The deletion removes the forward rush and the explicit joint participation of Abimelech and his accompanying companies. “占据城门口” can naturally continue with an implicit subject supplied by 9:43; it is not ungrammatical. However, the edited wording may now attribute the gate occupation only to the preceding singular subject rather than explicitly to Abimelech and his companies.
  • Judges 9:42–45 · 占据城门口； — The edited verse naturally contrasts the forward rush of Abimelech's group with the attack by the other two companies. It no longer states that the first group occupied the city-gate entrance. The supplied result is an exact deletion.
  • Judges 9:42–45 · 另外两队则冲向田间所有的人， (other meaning changed · recoverable from context) — The rush by the other two companies against everyone in the fields disappears. The remaining “击杀他们” permits an implicit subject and can refer back to the people mentioned in 9:43, so the exact edited wording remains grammatical. Its natural subject is now Abimelech and his accompanying companies, whereas the source assigns this killing to the other two companies; this is an additional attribution change.
  • Judges 9:42–45 · ，击杀他们 — The edited verse is grammatical and retains both groups' movements, but it no longer states that the two companies killed the people they rushed against. The later killing of the city's people does not explicitly preserve this particular field-attack outcome.
  • Judges 9:42–45 · 直到把城攻下， — The edited verse naturally states that Abimelech attacked the city all day and killed its inhabitants, but no longer explicitly states that he captured the city or that capture marked the endpoint of the fighting.
  • Judges 9:42–45 · ，杀了城中的百姓 — The edited verse is grammatical and retains the city's capture, demolition, and salting, but removes the killing of its inhabitants. The killings in the fields in 9:44 do not explicitly preserve this separate statement about the city's people.
  • Judges 9:42–45 · 他拆毁那城， — The deletion removes the demolition of the city. “随后，在城址上撒了盐。” is natural Chinese with Abimelech understood as its subject from the preceding sentence. The retained reference to the city site does not explicitly state the demolition action.
  • Judges 9:42–45 · ，在城址上撒了盐 — 删除后不再陈述亚比米勒在城址上撒盐这一独立行动；英文明确支持该行动。剩余文字“随后，他拆毁那城。”自然完整，且编辑仅删除指定片段。五项检查均通过。
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 示剑楼里的所有首领听见这事， (recoverable from context) — The deletion removes the leaders' hearing of the news and their explicit identification as the people entering. The remaining “就进了伊勒比利土庙的内室。” permits an implicit subject, recoverable from the leaders mentioned in 9:47. That recovery does not restore the deleted hearing event.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · ，就进了伊勒比利土庙的内室 (recoverable from context) — The edited sentence naturally states only that the leaders heard of the matter. Their subsequent entry into the named temple's inner chamber is deleted. Later references to their gathering and to the inner chamber provide contextual clues, but do not preserve the explicit entry event or the temple's name.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 有人告诉亚比米勒， (ambiguous reference · recoverable from context) — The gathering remains explicitly stated, but the event of someone informing Abimelech disappears. This is not redundant speech framing: it reports his receipt of information. The resulting Chinese remains grammatical. The following “他” loses its preceding explicit antecedent, although the subsequent naming of 亚比米勒 makes the intended referent recoverable.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 示剑楼里的所有首领都聚集在那里， (possible other meaning changed · recoverable from context) — The specific content of the report—the gathering of all the tower's leaders there—is no longer stated. In the full window, “有人告诉亚比米勒，他就带着所有的人上了撒们山。” allows a natural reading with an implicit, contextually recoverable message followed by his response. It also permits a secondary reading in which the following clause is what someone told him, rather than the narrator's account of his subsequent action.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 他就带着所有的人上了撒们山。 — 删除后不再叙述亚比米勒带所有人上撒们山的行动及地点。余文能够自然接续9:47的报告，且是原文的精确删除。
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 亚比米勒手拿斧头， (recoverable from context) — 手拿斧头的动作及斧头这一工具不再明说。虽然删除了重复出现的人名，但“砍下一根树枝”的隐含主语可由前句的“他”和9:47的亚比米勒恢复，跨句承接在中文中成立。
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 砍下一根树枝， (other meaning changed · recoverable from context) — 删除使亚比米勒砍下一根树枝的事件不再明说；9:49众人“也都砍了一根树枝”可帮助推知，却不能替代这一明确叙述。余句语法自然，但“手拿斧头，举起来扛在肩上”使被举起的对象自然变为斧头，而原文是树枝，这是额外的指称变化。
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 举起来扛在肩上， — 删除后仍明确叙述拿斧、砍枝及发出指令，但不再叙述把树枝举起扛在肩上的行动。砍枝后直接接说话自然通顺，且没有增加或替换文字。
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 对跟随他的人说： (recoverable from context) — The deletion removes the explicit identification of the command's recipients as Abimelech's followers. The remaining direct quotation can naturally follow the action narration without a reporting verb; its speaker and audience are recoverable from the surrounding narrative.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 你们看见我怎样做， (recoverable from context) — The edited command remains natural: 也要赶快照着做 refers back to Abimelech's narrated demonstration. However, it no longer explicitly states that the men have seen what he did. The surviving instruction to imitate him does not itself state that observation.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · ，也要赶快照着做 — The remaining quotation, 你们看见我怎样做, is a grammatical statement about what the men have observed. It no longer commands them to imitate Abimelech or to hurry. Their subsequent actions do not preserve the explicit instruction in this statement.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 每个人也都砍了一根树枝， (recoverable from context) — The deletion removes each man's cutting a branch. The remaining 于是，跟着亚比米勒 has an implicit subject recoverable from the men addressed immediately beforehand and from the following 他们; this is permissible in the displayed Chinese context. Later piling the branches does not explicitly preserve the distinct cutting event.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · ，跟着亚比米勒 — The exact deletion removes the men's action of following Abimelech after cutting branches. The remaining sentences naturally describe cutting, piling, and burning without explicitly stating that movement.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 他们把树枝堆在内室旁边， (recoverable from context) — The exact deletion removes the piling of branches beside the inner chamber. “在里面众人的上方放火焚烧” can naturally continue with the men as its implicit subject; “里面” remains interpretable through the inner chamber mentioned in 9:46.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 在里面众人的上方放火焚烧， — The exact deletion removes the explicit fire-setting action and its position above the occupants. “他们把树枝堆在内室旁边，烧死了……” remains grammatical. The surviving burning outcome does not explicitly preserve the distinct ignition action or its location.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 烧死了示剑楼里所有的人， — The exact deletion removes the explicit statement that everyone in the tower died. The remaining “男女约有一千” naturally supplies the number of the previously mentioned 众人; it does not require the deleted killing clause for grammatical completeness.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · ，男女约有一千 — 删除后仍自然、完整地陈述示剑楼里所有人被烧死，但不再明确说明死者包括男女、人数约为一千。该信息有英文直接支持，且编辑仅删除指定文字。
  • Judges 9:50–53 · 亚比米勒来到提备斯， (ambiguous reference · recoverable from context) — The deletion removes Abimelech’s arrival at the named destination Thebez and his explicit identification as the actor in this verse. The remaining coordinated predicates permit an implicit subject in Chinese; 9:52 helps recover that subject. However, “那城” no longer has a named antecedent in the displayed window. This referential weakening does not make the sentence ungrammatical.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · 扎营攻城， — The edited verse naturally states that Abimelech arrived at Thebez and captured the city, but no longer states the intervening encampment against it. Retaining the capture does not preserve that distinct action.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · ，夺取了那城 — The remaining verse is grammatical and preserves the arrival and military action against Thebez. It no longer asserts that the city was captured; the subsequent tower episode does not explicitly restate that outcome.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · 城里有一座坚固的楼， (ambiguous reference · recoverable from context) — The deletion removes the explicit introduction of a strong tower inside the city. The remaining Chinese is grammatical, although “那里” loses its immediately preceding antecedent. “楼顶” and the following attack on the tower allow readers to recover the refuge’s identity, but do not explicitly restore its strength or its location inside the city.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · 把门锁上， — The edited sentence naturally says that the city's inhabitants fled into the tower and climbed to its roof. It no longer states the distinct intervening action of locking themselves in.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · ，登上楼顶 — The edited sentence remains grammatical and complete, ending with the refugees locking the door. Their ascent to the tower roof is no longer stated.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · 亚比米勒前来攻楼， (recoverable from context) — The edited verse naturally permits an implicit subject recoverable as Abimelech from the surrounding attack narrative. It retains his approach to the entrance and intention to burn the tower, but removes the explicit event of his coming to attack it. That event is not identical to the retained approach to its doorway.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · 走近楼门， — Accepted. The exact deletion leaves natural Chinese but removes Abimelech’s distinct action of approaching the tower entrance; attacking the tower and intending to burn it do not explicitly express that movement.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · ，要放火焚烧 — Accepted. The edited verse remains grammatical and retains the attack and approach, but no longer states the intended burning.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · ，砸碎了他的头骨 — The exact deletion leaves a natural, complete Chinese sentence describing the millstone being thrown onto Abimelech’s head, but removes the explicitly stated outcome that his skull was crushed.
Rejected (163)
  • 1 Kings 13:1–3 · 忽然， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • 1 Kings 13:1–3 · ，从犹大来到伯特利 — The journey and both named places are removed. However, the remaining construction “有一个神人奉耶和华的话。” is unfinished in this context: 奉耶和华的话 introduces the authority for an action, but no action follows it.
  • 1 Kings 13:1–3 · 祭坛哪， (unit phrase) — The exact deletion leaves a natural single address, “祭坛哪！” It removes repetition and emphasis, not information about the addressee or prophecy.
  • 1 Kings 13:1–3 · ，祭坛哪 (unit phrase) — Deleting the second address produces the same fluent single address as candidate 6. The addressee and all substantive prophetic content remain explicit.
  • 1 Kings 13:1–3 · 耶和华如此说： — The retained “他奉耶和华的话向祭坛呼喊说” still explicitly attributes the message to the LORD, and the prophecy remains intact. The nested quotation can stand without a separate introductory speech formula.
  • 1 Kings 13:1–3 · 大卫家必生一个儿子， (ambiguous reference) — The deletion removes the predicted birth and Davidic family relationship. The remaining opening “名叫约西亚。他必……” is not natural in this window: the naming predicate lacks an introduced or contextually identifiable human subject. The preceding altar address and divine speech formula do not supply the intended future son.
  • 1 Kings 13:1–3 · 说： (unit word) — The direct quotation still presents the man of God's words immediately after his sign-giving action. Removing 说 leaves a readable direct-quotation construction and removes only redundant speech framing, not a distinct event or attribution.
  • 1 Kings 13:6–7 · 为我祷告， — In this request, '为我祷告' restates the intercession already requested by '请你恳求耶和华你的神.' The retained purpose '使我的手恢复原状' still identifies the king as its beneficiary. No distinct prayer event, beneficiary, or purpose is lost.
  • 1 Kings 13:6–7 · ，和从前一样 — In this window, “王的手就恢复了” already communicates restoration to the former condition, especially following the request “使我的手恢复原状”. Removing the explicit restatement “和从前一样” does not remove a distinct outcome or substantive condition.
  • 1 Kings 13:11–14 · 当时， (unit word) — The deletion removes introductory narrative framing, not a distinct temporal condition or event. The remaining Chinese is grammatical and preserves the substantive statement.
  • 1 Kings 13:11–14 · 他走哪条路去了？ (recoverable from context) — Rejected for fluency. The exact remaining construction “父亲问他们：“”儿子们就……” introduces direct speech with a colon but supplies an empty quotation, leaving an unfilled quotation slot. The sons' response suggests the missing topic but does not repair the displayed text.
  • 1 Kings 13:11–14 · 给我备驴。 — The deletion removes the actual instruction, but the exact result retains the malformed construction “于是先知对儿子们说：“”他们就为他备好驴”. The empty quotation after 说： leaves the announced direct speech without any content, so the supplied text is not natural narrative Chinese.
  • 1 Kings 13:11–14 · 就问： — The direct question and its answer still express the questioning event. Chinese narrative permits a direct quotation after an action clause without an explicit speech verb; the prophet remains the contextually clear questioner. Removing “就问：” therefore removes redundant speech framing rather than substantive information.
  • 1 Kings 13:11–14 · 你是从犹大来的神人吗？ (recoverable from context) — 删除了老先知询问对方是否为从犹大来的神人的具体内容。但剩下的“就问：“”他回答：“是我。””包含空的问话引语，后面的“是我”也失去明确的提问依托，不能作为自然完整的对话。
  • 1 Kings 13:11–14 · 他回答： (recoverable from context) — 删除“他回答：”后，紧接身份问题的“是我。”仍自然构成被询问者的回答，回答行为、肯定内容和说话者均可由对话结构确定。这是冗余话语框架的省略，不是具体事件或身份信息的消失。
  • 1 Kings 13:11–14 · 是我。 (recoverable from context) — 删除了神人对身份问题的肯定答复。剩下的“他回答：“””是没有内容的直接引语，不能自然完成这个回答结构。上下文虽已说明其身份，却不再明确表达他亲自作出肯定确认。
  • 1 Kings 13:20–22 · ，你的尸体必不得葬入你祖先的坟墓 — 删除确实去掉了神人不得葬入祖坟的判决，且完全符合所示删除操作。但结合13:21，剩余引语是“因为你违背了耶和华的话，没有遵守……，反而回去……吃了饭、喝了水。”整个宣告只剩“因为”引出的原因部分，没有承接的主句；上下文也不是允许单独回答原因的问答，因此句法不完整。
  • 1 Kings 13:23–25 · 有一头狮子在路上遇见他， (ambiguous reference · possible other meaning changed) — The deletion removes the lion's roadside encounter with the traveler and its explicit establishment as the killer. The remaining construction 他上路后，将他咬死 is not natural here: its available subject is the traveler, while 将他咬死 requires a different biting agent. The later mention of the lion standing beside the body does not naturally establish that missing subject. Subject continuity can also misleadingly suggest that the traveler performs the killing.
  • 1 Kings 13:26–30 · 就说： (possible other meaning changed) — The removed words are generic speech framing: the prophet and the entire quoted explanation remain. However, the exact construction 先知听见了，“这是那违背耶和华命令的神人 leaves the quotation awkwardly attached to a hearing clause rather than naturally introducing his response. It also risks making the quotation sound like something he heard instead of something he said.
  • 1 Kings 13:26–30 · 因此， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • 1 Kings 13:26–30 · 给我备驴。 (recoverable from context) — 删除了备驴命令的具体内容，但余文“老先知就吩咐儿子们：“”他们便备好了驴。”保留了引出直接引语的冒号和空引号，形成没有话语内容的直接引语结构，不是自然完整的叙述。后面的执行行为可以帮助推知命令，却不能使这个空引语结构流畅。
  • 1 Kings 13:26–30 · ，也没有撕咬驴 — 删除确实移除了狮子没有撕咬驴的事实，但精确编辑结果“狮子既没有吃尸体。”留下了没有后续配对成分的“既”。这里既没有“也／又”等承接项，也没有可支持因果用法的后句，因此该句在所给窗口中不自然、不完整。
  • 1 Kings 13:26–30 · 说： (unit word) — “众人为他哀哭，‘哀哉，我的兄弟！’”仍自然地把引语呈现为众人的哀哭话语；引语内容和归属均保留。删除“说：”只是省去冗余的引语引导词，没有删除独立的实质事件。
  • 1 Kings 13:26–30 · 哀哉， (unit word) — 删除“哀哉”减弱了引语中的显式感叹，但“众人为他哀哭”和“我的兄弟！”仍保留悲痛场景、话语归属及兄弟称呼。剩余呼语自然，没有实质命题内容被删除。
  • 1 Kings 13:33–34 · ，他都任命 (recoverable from context) — 余下的“凡愿意作丘坛祭司的。”只有条件性话题，没有说明这些人如何，作为此处的独立陈述不完整。前句虽已提到设立祭司，却未明确表达所有自愿者都获任命。
  • 1 Kings 13:33–34 · 使他家被铲除， (possible other meaning changed · recoverable from context) — “这就是耶罗波安家的罪，从地上灭绝。”衔接不自然：末尾谓语直接接在认定“罪”的判断句后，缺少自然承接家族这一受事的结构，容易读成罪本身从地上灭绝。被删内容明确表达的罪导致家族覆灭的因果关系也不再陈述。
  • 2 Chronicles 26:3–5 · 他行耶和华眼中看为正的事， — 删除了乌西雅行耶和华眼中看为正之事的明确陈述。剩下的“正如他父亲亚玛谢所行的。”只有比较从句，没有被比较的主句；前文的年龄、在位年数和母亲身份也不能提供适切的比较对象，因此不构成自然完整的表述。
  • 2 Chronicles 26:3–5 · ，上帝就使他亨通 — 删除确实移除了上帝使他亨通的结果，但余下独立句“只要他寻求耶和华。”只有条件从句，没有相应主句；所显示的上文也没有提供可自然省略的结果陈述，因此句法和语意悬空。
  • 2 Chronicles 26:9–10 · 乌西雅在耶路撒冷的角门、谷门和城墙转角处建造城楼， (ambiguous reference) — The deletion removes Uzziah's construction of towers at three specified Jerusalem locations. The remaining sentence “并加以巩固。” is not a natural standalone statement in this window: “并” lacks a preceding coordinated action, and “加以巩固” has no identifiable object. The subsequent desert towers do not establish the deleted Jerusalem towers as its object.
  • 2 Chronicles 26:16–18 · 便心高气傲， (possible other meaning changed) — 确实删除了乌西雅的骄傲及其致祸作用。但剩余“但乌西雅强盛以后，以致自取灭亡”中，“强盛以后”只是时间从句，直接接结果连接语“以致”，缺少承接时间从句并引出结果的主句谓语，结构不完整。此外，勉强理解时可能把强盛本身读成灭亡的原因，而原文明确以骄傲为原因。
  • 2 Chronicles 26:16–18 · 对他说： — Rejected because only redundant speech framing disappears. The action clause followed by direct quotation remains a natural narrative construction: the priests are still the speakers, and the vocative “乌西雅” still identifies their addressee.
  • 2 Chronicles 26:16–18 · 乌西雅， (unit word) — Rejected because removing the repeated vocative does not remove the participant or change the statement. “乌西雅王，对他说” already explicitly identifies whom the priests address, and the quotation beginning “你没有权利” is natural.
  • 2 Chronicles 26:16–18 · ，才可以烧香 (recoverable from context · unit phrase) — Following “你没有权利向耶和华烧香”, “只有亚伦的后裔，就是那些分别为圣的祭司” functions as an elliptical contrast identifying who does have that right. Although the permission predicate is deleted, the same restriction remains expressed through contextual ellipsis rather than a distinct event or qualification disappearing.
  • 2 Chronicles 26:21–23 · ，自始至终都由亚摩斯的儿子以赛亚先知记载下来 — 拒绝，原因是流畅性不合格。剩下的“乌西雅其余的事迹。”只是名词性话题，没有任何陈述；在此连续叙事窗口中也没有标题或列项结构支持它独立成句。删除内容本身确实有原文依据，且造成实质信息损失。
  • 2 Chronicles 26:21–23 · 因为众人说： — The deletion removes both the attribution to the people and the explicit causal connection to the burial arrangement. However, the remaining construction “葬在列祖附近、属于王室墓地的一块田里，“他患了麻风病。”” abruptly appends an unattached direct quotation to the burial narration, without a speech introduction or a natural syntactic connection.
  • 2 Chronicles 26:21–23 · 他患了麻风病。 (recoverable from context) — The people's stated explanation—that Uzziah had leprosy—is removed, although his disease is established in verse 26:21. The exact remaining construction “因为众人说：“”他儿子约坦接替他作王。” contains an empty quotation after “说”, leaving the causal explanation unexpressed and the prose malformed.
  • 2 Kings 11:1–3 · ，约阿施和他的乳母一同藏在耶和华的殿里六年 — 删除确实移除了约阿施与乳母在耶和华殿里藏匿六年的记述，但剩余的“亚他利雅统治那地期间。”只是时间状语，没有陈述该期间发生何事。前一节已完整结束，不能为这一独立残句提供主句，因此不符合流畅性要求。
  • 2 Kings 11:4–8 · 吩咐他们说： (recoverable from context) — This removes the explicit speech-introduction formula, but the direct quotation still gives Jehoiada’s commands to the same men. “你们要这样做” and the following 要、必须 constructions retain the directive force. The quotation can naturally follow the preceding narrative without a repeated speech verb; its speaker and addressees remain recoverable from 11:4.
  • 2 Kings 11:4–8 · 你们要这样做： — “你们要这样做” introduces the instructions rather than adding a separate duty. The edited quotation immediately states those duties, and “吩咐他们说” still explicitly identifies them as commands. The remaining Chinese is natural and grammatical.
  • 2 Kings 11:4–8 · ，你们都必须紧随左右 — Rejected for fluency. The exact result ends with 无论王往哪里去。, an unfinished dependent construction: 无论 introduces a condition but no main clause states what applies under that condition. The deletion nevertheless genuinely removes the source-supported close-following instruction.
  • 2 Kings 11:9–11 · 他们各自带着手下的人， (possible other meaning changed) — 删除确实移除了各百夫长带领自己手下的行动。但余文“包括在安息日上值和下值的，来到耶何耶大祭司那里”不自然：“包括……”失去其所补充说明的人群，不能直接作为“来到”的主语；这不只是省略一个可恢复的主语。余文也可能使读者把上值和下值者直接理解为到来者，而不再明确百夫长带队的关系。
  • 2 Kings 11:15–16 · ，都用刀杀死 — The instruction to execute her followers by the sword is deleted. The exact remainder “把她从队列之间带出去，凡跟随她的人。” is not a complete natural instruction: 凡跟随她的人 introduces a nominal topic but supplies no predicate telling what should happen to those people. It cannot naturally function as an attachment to the preceding completed command about 她.
  • 2 Kings 11:15–16 · 不可在耶和华的殿里杀她。 — 删除了有明确来源支持的禁令，但留下“因为祭司曾说：“””，其中引号内没有任何话语，“曾说”引出的内容及原因解释均悬空，不构成自然完整的叙述。
  • 2 Kings 11:15–16 · 于是， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • 2 Kings 6:24–25 · 过了一些时候， — The exact deletion leaves a grammatical sentence and removes the explicit indication that some time elapsed. However, this nonspecific temporal transition does not remove a concrete participant, action, outcome, or substantive condition.
  • 2 Kings 6:24–25 · 他们围城日久， (possible other meaning changed) — The prolonged siege is no longer stated. However, the remaining construction “于是撒马利亚发生了大饥荒。以致一个驴头卖到……” awkwardly isolates the dependent result introduced by “以致” after a full stop, rather than naturally attaching it to its governing clause. The deletion also makes famine, rather than the prolonged siege, the apparent immediate explanation for the prices.
  • 2 Kings 6:29–31 · 把你的儿子交出来， (ambiguous reference · recoverable from context) — The instruction to hand over the other woman’s son is genuinely removed. However, the remaining standalone quotation “我们好吃他。” is an unnatural purposive fragment: “好” here means “so that we can” and lacks the enabling instruction it originally followed. “他” also loses its local antecedent, although the following sentence helps identify the intended child.
  • 2 Kings 6:29–31 · ，愿上帝重重地惩罚我 — The deletion removes the king’s invocation of severe divine punishment upon himself. However, the remaining quotation, “今天沙法的儿子以利沙的头若还留在他的肩上！”, retains the conditional marker “若” without a consequent. Neither the exclamation mark nor the surrounding verses completes that conditional construction, so the exact edited verse is not a natural, complete statement.
  • 2 Kings 6:32–33 · 那时， (unit word) — Rejected: deleting the scene-opening marker “那时” leaves the same events and their temporal relationships expressed. The edited Chinese is grammatical and is an exact deletion.
  • 2 Kings 6:32–33 · 以利沙就对长老们说： (ambiguous reference · recoverable from context) — The deletion removes the explicit identification of Elisha as speaker and the elders as addressees. These are recoverable from the surrounding verses, but the exact remaining construction, “但使者还没到，‘你们看见了吗？’”, awkwardly attaches direct speech to a narrative clause about the messenger's nonarrival, with neither a reporting construction nor a separate dialogue boundary. This is not merely an omitted recoverable subject.
  • 2 Kings 6:32–33 · 你们看见了吗？ — In the paired English, this question introduces the assertion about the murderer's sending someone to behead Elisha. It functions as a rhetorical appeal for recognition, not as a separate report of seeing. The edited Chinese preserves that entire substantive assertion and reads naturally.
  • 2 Kings 6:32–33 · 你们留意， — The deletion removes an attention-getting discourse marker corresponding to “Look,” not a substantive instruction distinct from the following command. The timing, door-closing action, and exclusion of the messenger remain explicit. The edited Chinese is fluent.
  • 2 Kings 6:32–33 · ，不是有他主人的脚步声吗 — The master's footsteps are genuinely omitted. However, the remaining standalone question “在他后面？” has no predicate or contextually established proposition to question. The preceding instruction to keep the messenger outside does not supply a natural elliptical reading for this locative fragment.
  • 2 Kings 7:1–2 · 耶和华如此说： — Rejected. “你们要听耶和华的话！” still explicitly identifies the following quoted prediction as the LORD’s word. Removing the repeated introductory formula does not remove a distinct substantive claim. The retained nested quotation is intelligible and grammatical after that introduction.
  • 2 Kings 7:1–2 · 一细亚细面要卖一舍客勒银子， — The flour-price prediction is genuinely deleted. However, the remaining construction “两细亚大麦也要卖一舍客勒银子” retains additive “也” after the only parallel price statement has disappeared. No other statement in the displayed window supplies that comparison, making the edited wording contextually unnatural.
  • 2 Kings 7:1–2 · 看哪， (unit word) — The exact deletion removes only the attention-getting interjection “看哪”. The officer’s hypothetical condition and skeptical question remain intact, and the edited Chinese is grammatical.
  • 2 Kings 7:1–2 · ，这事真能发生吗 — The exact deletion removes the officer’s explicit question about whether the prediction can happen. However, the remaining “看哪，就算耶和华在天上开了窗户？” leaves the concessive clause introduced by “就算” without a main clause. In this displayed exchange it is an incomplete utterance, not a natural standalone question.
  • 2 Kings 7:3–4 · 当时， (unit word) — 删除“当时，”仅去掉对应英文“Now”的叙事引入语，没有删去独立的时间条件或事件。剩余中文自然，人物、地点和对话均保留。
  • 2 Kings 7:3–4 · 来吧， — Here “来吧” introduces and reinforces the proposal to go to the Aramean camp; it does not describe a separate movement event. “我们到亚兰人的营地去” retains the proposal, participants, destination, and action. Only the introductory exhortation is removed.
  • 2 Kings 7:3–4 · 我们就活； (possible other meaning changed · recoverable from context) — The explicit survival outcome is removed. The remaining “他们若让我们活，他们若杀我们，我们就死” leaves the first conditional without its corresponding result and runs it into the opposing conditional. Reading both conditions as nested would instead make being spared a condition for the killing-and-death scenario.
  • 2 Kings 7:3–4 · ，我们就死 (recoverable from context) — The explicit death outcome is deleted. The exact ending “他们若杀我们。” is an unfinished conditional: it supplies the condition but no consequent. Death is readily inferable from killing, but the edited sentence no longer explicitly states that outcome and does not form a natural completed conditional.
  • 2 Kings 7:8–9 · 随后， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • 2 Kings 7:8–9 · 最后， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • 2 Kings 7:8–9 · 他们彼此说： (recoverable from context) — The deletion removes the explicit attribution and reciprocal exchange. The lepers remain inferable as the speakers, but the exact opening 最后，“我们这样做不对。 leaves the narrative temporal adverb attached directly to an unintroduced quotation, without a reporting predicate. This is an abrupt fragment in the displayed prose, rather than ordinary implicit-subject Chinese.
  • 2 Kings 7:8–9 · ，我们的罪必追上我们 — The threatened consequence is genuinely removed. However, the remaining sentence '如果我们不作声，等到天亮。' leaves the condition without a consequent. The separate sentence '现在，我们去向王宫报信吧。' does not naturally complete that conditional construction.
  • 2 Kings 7:8–9 · 现在， (unit word) — Here '现在' introduces the proposal following their recognition of wrongdoing and the warning against delay. Removing it leaves the same current proposal to go report the news; it primarily removes the explicit transition and emphasis on immediacy.
  • 2 Kings 7:8–9 · ，我们去向王宫报信吧 — 删除确实移除了众人提议前往王宫报信的内容，且是纯删除。但剩余的“现在。”只是孤立的时间词，没有所修饰的行动或可自然承接的谓语，在此语境中不能构成完整、自然的结语，因此不通过流畅性检查。
  • 2 Kings 7:10–11 · 说： (unit word) — “呼喊”后直接接引语自然成立，发言者、接收者、发言行动和内容都仍明确。“说”只是重复引出同一段话，没有独立信息消失。
  • 2 Kings 7:10–11 · 那里一个人也没有， — 保留的“连个人影都不见”在此处仍明确表达营地无人，且地点由前句交代。删除的是同一情况的重复陈述，并未删去独立事实。
  • 2 Kings 7:10–11 · 连个人影都不见， — 删除准确，余句自然。“连个人影都不见”在此强化“那里一个人也没有”，并未另述一个独立事实；删除后无人这一陈述仍完整保留。
  • 2 Kings 7:12–13 · 心想： (recoverable from context) — The nested quotation still presents the Arameans' imagined plan within the king's explanation of their strategy. Removing 心想 leaves an understandable unintroduced quotation rather than removing the plan or a distinct substantive event. Its interpretation as their represented thought remains recoverable from the quotation structure and context.
  • 2 Kings 7:12–13 · 你也看到了， — Rejected. In this context, “你也看到了” appeals to the listener's recognition of the following proposition rather than reporting a distinct observation event. Removing it leaves the same substantive assertion that all the Israelites there are doomed.
  • 2 Kings 7:14–16 · 说： (unit word) — Removing “说：” leaves the command quoted immediately after the king's dispatch action. Chinese permits this juxtaposition without an explicit speech verb; the speaker and spoken content remain clear. No substantive source information disappears.
  • 2 Kings 7:14–16 · 你们去看看。 — The instruction to go and see is removed. However, the exact remaining construction “说：“”” introduces direct speech with an empty quotation, leaving the utterance incomplete rather than forming natural finished narration.
  • 2 Kings 7:14–16 · 那时， (unit phrase) — “那时”在此承接刚叙述的事件，强调粮价出现的叙事时点。删除后相邻叙事仍表达同一时段的粮价情况，没有删除独立事件或实质时间条件；减少的是显式衔接和时间强调。
  • 2 Samuel 21:15–17 · 那时， (unit phrase) — 那时 is a standalone narrative transition here, corresponding to “Then.” Removing it leaves the same decision and weapon descriptions within the ongoing battle narrative; no distinct event, specified time, or substantive temporal condition disappears.
  • 2 Samuel 21:15–17 · 于是， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • 2 Samuel 21:15–17 · 大卫的部下向他起誓说： (ambiguous reference) — 说话者、起誓对象及起誓行为均被删除。剩余“于是，‘你绝不可再和我们一同出战，免得以色列的灯熄灭。’”在这里是未接叙述谓语的过渡语加孤立引语；上下文也未建立可自然承接的对话轮次。这不只是允许省略主语的情形。
  • 2 Samuel 21:15–17 · 你绝不可再和我们一同出战， — 删除了不许大卫再次随部下出战的禁令。剩余“起誓说：‘免得以色列的灯熄灭。’”只保留由“免得”引导的目的分句，没有说明为避免该结果应采取什么行动，不能自然独立充当这里的誓言内容。
  • 2 Samuel 21:20–22 · 那里有一个身材高大的人， (ambiguous reference) — The deletion removes the introduction of the large man at the battle. The remaining construction “在迦特也发生了一场战斗，每只手有六根手指” abruptly moves from a battle to someone's hands without establishing their owner. Neither the preceding displayed context nor the later pronouns identify an already introduced individual who could naturally supply this missing topic.
  • 2 Samuel 21:20–22 · ，大卫的兄弟示每的儿子约拿单杀了他 (recoverable from context) — The deletion removes Jonathan's identity, his family relationships, and his killing of the man. However, the exact remainder “他辱骂以色列时。” is an unfinished temporal construction: “时” makes it mean “when he taunted Israel,” without a main clause. The separate sentence in 21:22 does not grammatically complete it. That later verse does recover the man's death generally, but not Jonathan's specific role.
  • Acts 19:13–16 · 当时， (unit word) — 删除的是承接叙事的“当时”，对应英文“Now”，没有删除具体时间或独立事件。剩余句子自然，且确为纯删除，但不构成实质信息遗漏。
  • Acts 19:13–16 · 他们说： (recoverable from context) — 前句已明确介绍赶鬼者及其呼求行为，紧接的直接引语仍自然表达他们所说的话。“他们说”只是可省略的通用引语框架；删除它没有使一个独立的说话事件或话语内容消失。
  • Acts 19:13–16 · 我奉保罗所传的耶稣命令你们。 — 删除了赶鬼者所说的具体命令，包括借保罗所传的耶稣命令邪灵这一内容。但剩下的“他们说：“””保留了引语引导语和空引号，没有任何话语内容，在当前叙述中不构成自然完整的表达。
  • Acts 19:13–16 · 做这事的， (recoverable from context · unit phrase) — “是犹太祭司长士基瓦的七个儿子。”可承接上一节，省略的主语就是从事上述赶鬼行为的人。它仍表达同一身份判断，并未删除独立事件或关系。
  • Acts 19:13–16 · ，是犹太祭司长士基瓦的七个儿子 — 删除了行为者的身份、人数和亲属关系。剩下的“做这事的。”只是名词性结构，没有完成身份判断；当前上下文也没有可使它成为自然独立回答的提问。
  • Acts 19:13–16 · 邪灵回答说： (ambiguous reference) — 删除了邪灵作出回答的事件及引语的说话者归属。剩余的“但有一天，‘耶稣我认识，保罗我也知道，你们却是谁？’”把时间状语直接接到引语上，缺少承接该时间状语的叙述谓语，形成不自然的叙述残句；问题不只是省略了显式主语。
  • Acts 19:13–16 · 随后， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Acts 19:17–20 · 因此， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Acts 19:17–20 · 这样， (unit word) — Deleting the introductory discourse connective does not remove a distinct proposition. The retained “就” and the surrounding sequence still express the consequential connection, while all information about the Lord’s word remains.
  • Acts 19:17–20 · 主的道就大有能力地不断传开， (ambiguous reference · possible other meaning changed) — The deletion removes both the identification of the Lord’s word and its powerful continuing spread. The remaining “这样，日益兴旺。” lacks a contextually established subject for “兴旺”: the immediately preceding discussion concerns books and their monetary value. Unlike an ordinary recoverable-subject omission, this leaves the assertion dangling. Supplying an inferred community as subject would also change what is said to flourish.
  • Acts 20:7–9 · 有一个名叫犹推古的青年， (ambiguous reference · possible other meaning changed) — The deletion removes the introduction and identity of the person who falls. The remaining standalone sentence “坐在窗台上。” has no contextually established subject matching the intended young man, and the subsequent “他渐渐困倦” likewise lacks that antecedent. This is not ordinary recoverable subject omission: Paul is the only previously named individual, so the edited sequence also risks attributing the sleeping and fall to him.
  • Acts 20:10–12 · 说： (unit word) — 剩余的“抱住他，‘不要惊慌！他还活着！’”采用动作叙述后直接接引语的表达，读者仍自然理解为保罗说出这些话。引语内容和说话者均保留，删除的只是通用引语框架，没有独立的实质信息损失。
  • Acts 23:12–15 · 起誓不吃不喝， (possible other meaning changed · recoverable from context) — 起誓以及不吃不喝的具体承诺确实被删除。剩余的“结成阴谋，直到杀死保罗”搭配不自然：“结成”表达形成这一有界事件，不能自然承接“直到……”所要求的持续状态或活动。原句的截止条件约束禁食禁饮，删后却可能被理解为约束阴谋活动。
  • Acts 23:12–15 · 说： (unit word) — The direct quotation still presents the conspirators' speech, with attribution supplied by the immediately preceding 他们去见祭司长和长老. Juxtaposing the narrative clause and quotation is acceptable Chinese. Removing 说： does not remove a distinct source-supported proposition.
  • Acts 23:12–15 · 不吃任何东西， (possible other meaning changed · recoverable from context) — The prohibition on eating is genuinely deleted and is supported by both 23:14 and 23:12. However, the remaining construction 我们已经郑重起誓，直到杀死保罗 leaves 直到杀死保罗 without a natural continuing action or state to delimit: 已经郑重起誓 describes a completed oath-taking event. Forcing a reading could instead make the killing delimit the oath's duration, rather than the abstention.
  • Acts 23:12–15 · 现在， (unit word) — 现在 corresponds here to the transitional 'Now then,' introducing the proposed next step. Its deletion leaves the same substantive request and plan in natural Chinese.
  • Acts 23:16–18 · 说： (unit word) — The direct quotation still presents Paul’s spoken instruction following his summons of the centurion. Chinese naturally permits dialogue without an explicit speech verb in this construction. Removing 说： does not remove a distinct source-supported event or change the substantive message.
  • Acts 23:16–18 · 说： (unit word) — 删除的只是通用引语提示“说：”。编辑后动作叙述紧接直接引语，在汉语叙事中可以成立；百夫长的说话身份、受话对象和话语内容仍由句子及引号表达，没有独立实质信息消失。
  • Acts 23:19–22 · 问道： (unit word) — 剩余引语“你有什么事要告诉我？”本身仍明确表达询问，前面的动作叙述仍将说话者归于千夫长。动作描写直接接引语是可接受的中文表达；删除的只是冗余的询问引导语，没有消除独立事件或问题内容。
  • Acts 23:19–22 · 你有什么事要告诉我？ — 具体问题已被删除，只剩询问这一笼统行为。然而实际结果中的“问道：“””用冒号引出空引语，使直接引语结构悬空，不是自然完整的叙述。
  • Acts 23:19–22 · 他回答说： (recoverable from context) — The quotation still functions naturally as the young man's answer to the commander's immediately preceding question. Removing the generic answer introduction does not remove a distinct substantive event or change the report's content.
  • Acts 23:19–22 · 他们已经起誓不吃不喝， — The oath and commitment to abstain from food and drink are removed. The exact remainder “直到杀死他；现在他们已经准备好了” is not fluent: “直到杀死他” is a stranded temporal expression with no predicate for the activity continuing until that endpoint. The preceding full stop separates it from the attack report, and the following readiness statement does not supply the missing construction.
  • Acts 23:19–22 · 并嘱咐他说： — 删除的是引出直接引语的言说框架。保留的祈使句仍直接表达千夫长对年轻人的保密嘱咐；前面的叙述也足以确定说话者和受话者。动作叙述后直接接引语可以成立，不必补回言说动词。
  • Acts 23:19–22 · 不要告诉任何人你向我报告了这件事。 — 删除了整项保密指令，属于真实的信息损失；但剩余的“并嘱咐他说：“””引出了空引语，言说内容悬空，不能构成自然完整的叙述。
  • Acts 23:23–24 · 随后， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Acts 23:23–24 · 说： (unit word) — The direct quotation following “他叫来两位百夫长” still naturally presents his spoken orders. Removing “说：” eliminates redundant speech framing rather than a distinct source-supported event or instruction.
  • Acts 23:31–35 · 把信交给总督， (ambiguous reference · recoverable from context) — The deletion removes the delivery of the letter to the governor. However, the exact remaining construction “骑兵抵达凯撒利亚后，并把保罗带到他面前” leaves additive “并” introducing the sole main predicate after a temporal subordinate clause, without a suitable preceding coordinated main predicate. This is not a natural construction as supplied. It also removes the explicit antecedent of “他”; the following verse's governor helps recover the intended referent.
  • Acts 23:31–35 · 就说： (recoverable from context) — The quoted announcement and its contextually identifiable speaker remain, so removing 就说： eliminates redundant speech framing rather than a distinct substantive event. However, the exact cross-verse construction 得知他来自基利家，“等控告你的人到了，我会审理你的案子。” leaves the introductory learning clause attached directly to a quotation without a reporting predicate, making the transition syntactically awkward and incomplete.
  • Acts 23:31–35 · ，我会审理你的案子 (possible other meaning changed) — The promise to hear Paul's case is genuinely removed. However, the remaining quotation “等控告你的人到了。” leaves a temporal dependent clause without its main clause. Reading it instead as an instruction to wait would change the original promise into a directive and is not a secure grammatical continuation of the source.
  • Acts 23:31–35 · 随后， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Acts 23:31–35 · ，他下令把保罗看守在希律的总督府里 — The deletion removes the governor's order to keep Paul under guard in Herod's Praetorium. The exact result ends with “随后。”, a standalone temporal connector with no following event or predicate, so the remaining text is not fluent.
  • Judges 17:1–2 · 以法莲山地有一个人， (ambiguous reference) — The deletion removes Micah’s association with the hill country of Ephraim and the introductory identification of him as a man. The remaining opening “名叫米迦。” is a naming predicate without an established subject in the displayed window; the following “他” does not supply a preceding referent that makes this narrative opening natural.
  • Judges 17:1–2 · 愿我儿蒙耶和华赐福！ — 删除确实移除了母亲愿儿子蒙耶和华赐福的祝愿，且仅作了指定删除。但确切剩余文本“他母亲说：“””以冒号引出空引语，没有任何话语内容，在当前叙述中不是自然完整的表达，因此不通过流畅性检查。
  • Judges 17:7–8 · 有一个年轻的利未人， (ambiguous reference) — 删除确实移除了人物的引入、年龄和利未人身份。但窗口以“来自犹大的伯利恒，曾寄居在犹大宗族中。”开头，两个谓语均没有已经建立、可承接的主语；后文“这人”也预设人物已经被引入，不能自然补足这个开头。因此该版本在所给窗口中不够完整自然。
  • Judges 17:9–13 · 你从哪里来？ (recoverable from context) — 确实删除了询问来处的具体内容，但留下“米迦问他：“”他回答说”，其中冒号引出的直接问话为空，构成未填充的引语，不能作为自然完整的问答文本。
  • Judges 17:9–13 · 他回答说： — 相邻的提问与第一人称回答仍清楚构成问答，回答者由“米迦问他”中的受问者自然承接。“他回答说”在此是冗余的对话框架，删除后没有丢失独立的实质事件或回答内容。
  • Judges 17:9–13 · 耶和华必恩待我， — The prediction of the LORD's favor is genuinely removed. However, “现在我知道，因为有一个利未人作了我的祭司” leaves 知道 without an identifiable object: the following 因为 clause supplies a reason, not what Micah knows, and the preceding window supplies no recoverable proposition about divine favor.
  • Judges 18:1–2 · 那时， (unit phrase) — 删除的是开头的时间框架“那时”，没有独立的日期或时间条件消失。保留的“正在”和“直到那时”仍把叙述置于同一时间背景；编辑后的中文自然，且确为纯删除。
  • Judges 18:1–2 · ，他们还没有在以色列各支派中得到产业 — The deletion removes the stated reason for seeking territory. However, the exact remainder ends with “因为直到那时。”: a causal conjunction and temporal expression without a proposition explaining the cause. The result is incomplete.
  • Judges 18:1–2 · 于是， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Judges 18:1–2 · 但人从他们的宗族中派出五个勇士， (ambiguous reference · possible other meaning changed) — The dispatch by the Danites, selection from their clans, and identification as men of valor disappear. The remainder “于是，都是琐拉和以实陶人，去窥探、勘察那地。” is not a natural narrative continuation: “于是” introduces the static identification “都是琐拉和以实陶人” without an established group of emissaries, before shifting to their mission. Reading the implicit subject as the previously mentioned Danites instead risks attributing the origin and reconnaissance to the tribe generally.
  • Judges 18:1–2 · 你们去勘察那地。 (recoverable from context) — The quoted instruction disappears, although its mission content can be recovered from the preceding dispatch purpose. The exact remainder “他们吩咐这五个人说：“”这五个人进入以法莲山地” is not fluent: “说：” introduces an empty quotation rather than any utterance, immediately followed by the next narrative sentence.
  • Judges 18:7–8 · 你们发现了什么？ — The deletion removes what the brothers asked about. However, the exact remaining construction “他们的弟兄问他们：“”” introduces direct speech with a colon and then supplies an empty quotation. This leaves the displayed sentence visibly incomplete rather than a natural report of an unspecified question.
  • Judges 18:9–10 · 来吧， — “来吧” functions here as an exhortatory marker, corresponding to “Come on,” rather than a separate instruction to come to a particular place. “我们上去攻打他们！” retains the substantive proposal, so the deletion removes encouragement rather than distinct source information.
  • Judges 18:9–10 · 那地方， (recoverable from context · unit phrase) — The land remains the established topic. Removing “那地方，” leaves a natural implicit location for the completeness claim rather than removing a distinct place or assertion.
  • Judges 18:9–10 · 地上所有的， (unit phrase) — “那地方，无一缺少” naturally retains the claim that the place lacks nothing. In this window, “地上所有的” supplies an expansive formulation of that completeness, not a separately identified inventory or a contrastive geographical restriction.
  • Judges 18:9–10 · ，无一缺少 (unit phrase) — The deletion removes the assertion that nothing is lacking. The exact remainder, “那地方，地上所有的。”, consists of a location topic followed by an unfinished nominal expression; it supplies no predicate establishing what is true of that place or those things.
  • Judges 18:11–13 · 于是， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Judges 18:11–13 · 因此， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Judges 18:11–13 · ，直到今日仍叫玛哈尼但 — 确实删除了地点名称及其沿用至今的信息，但剩下的“因此，基列耶琳以西的那个地方。”只有连接语和名词短语，没有谓语，不能在此叙述语境中构成完整自然的陈述。
  • Judges 18:14–17 · 你们知道吗？ — In this announcement, “你们知道吗？” functions as an attention-getting rhetorical introduction. Removing it leaves the same explicit report about the house and its contents, the same attribution, and the same instruction. No substantive state of the listeners' knowledge is asserted in the original.
  • Judges 18:29–31 · ，给那城起名叫但 — The naming action and its result are removed. However, “他们按着祖先但的名字。” leaves a subject and an adjunct without a main predicate: it does not state what they did according to that name. The following sentences do not complete this construction.
  • Judges 18:29–31 · 摩西的孙子、革舜的儿子约拿单， (unit phrase) — 约拿单本人担任祭司以及他的父系关系被删除，但剩余句以“以及约拿单的子孙，作但支派的祭司”开头。“以及”缺少同一句内与之并列的前项，前面的完整设立偶像句不能自然充当该名词并列结构的前项，因此原样结果不通顺。
  • Judges 18:29–31 · 作但支派的祭司， (unit phrase) — 删除了约拿单及其子孙担任但支派祭司的职务关系。剩余“摩西的孙子、革舜的儿子约拿单，以及约拿单的子孙，直到那地的居民被掳的日子”只有人物名词组和时间限定，没有说明这些人物做什么或处于何种状态的主句谓语，因而句子不完整。
  • Judges 18:29–31 · ，一直都在那里 — The deletion removes the image's continued presence. The exact remainder, 上帝的殿在示罗的整个时期，但人为自己设立的米迦所雕刻的神像。, is a temporal adjunct followed by a noun phrase without a main predicate. 设立的 and 所雕刻的 modify 神像 rather than complete the sentence.
  • Judges 9:7–8 · 高声呼喊说： (recoverable from context) — The act of raising his voice and crying out is no longer stated, although the quotation still implies speech. The remaining construction “他就登上基利心山顶，“示剑的首领们啊”” abruptly attaches direct speech to a movement predicate with only a comma and no speech-introducing construction; it is not naturally integrated Chinese as supplied.
  • Judges 9:7–8 · 有一天， (unit phrase) — The deletion removes the explicit, indefinite temporal framing 'one day', and the remaining narrative is fluent. However, 有一天 supplies only a generic story-opening time marker, not a concrete setting, substantive condition, or distinct event.
  • Judges 9:7–8 · 请作我们的王。 — The deletion removes the actual request addressed to the olive tree. However, the exact remaining construction 它们对橄榄树说：‘’ introduces direct speech with a colon and empty quotation marks, leaving an incomplete speech presentation rather than natural running Chinese.
  • Judges 9:9–10 · 于是， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Judges 9:9–10 · 树木对无花果树说： (ambiguous reference) — The deletion removes the trees' explicit attribution and the fig tree as addressee. The exact remainder, “于是，‘请来作我们的王。’”, is not natural continuous narration: the narrator's “于是” introduces a transition but is followed only by an unattached quotation, with no narrative predicate connecting that transition to the speech. This is more than an omitted recoverable subject.
  • Judges 9:9–10 · 请来作我们的王。 — 删除确实移除了树木邀请无花果树来作王的请求，且未添加或替换文字。但剩余的“树木对无花果树说：‘’”以冒号引出空引语，留下未完成的话语内容，在所给窗口中不是自然完整的表达。
  • Judges 9:13–14 · 最后， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Judges 9:13–14 · 请来作我们的王。 — 删除确实移除了众树邀请荆棘来作王的内容，且没有增加或替换文字。但剩余的“对荆棘说：‘’”以冒号引出空引语，未提供任何话语内容，是未完成的引语结构，因此不通过流畅性检查。
  • Judges 9:15–17 · 就来躲在我的荫下； — The instruction to seek refuge in the thornbush's shade disappears. However, the remaining construction 你们若真心膏立我作你们的王，不然，愿火…… leaves the initial 若 condition without a consequent before switching to its alternative with 不然. The displayed result is syntactically incomplete.
  • Judges 9:15–17 · 如今， (unit word) — 如今 introduces the transition from the parable to its application. Removing this discourse marker leaves the same substantive statement and conditions, without making the Chinese ungrammatical.
  • Judges 9:21–25 · 随后， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Judges 9:21–25 · ，都承担这流血的罪 (unit phrase) — The deletion removes the outcome that Abimelech and the leaders bear the bloodguilt. The exact remainder ends with '使他们的兄弟亚比米勒和帮助他杀害兄弟的示剑首领。': causative '使' has its participants but no predicate stating what they are caused to do or undergo. The preceding and following verses do not complete this construction.
  • Judges 9:30–33 · 城长西布勒听见以别的儿子迦勒所说的话， (ambiguous reference) — The deletion removes Zebul’s identification and his hearing Gaal’s words. The remaining opening, “就怒火中烧。”, supplies neither an identifiable experiencer nor an antecedent situation for “就” in the displayed window; the following “他” does not establish either. It therefore reads as an unsupported fragment here, rather than a natural use of a recoverable implicit subject.
  • Judges 9:30–33 · 说： (unit word) — The quotation remains directly juxtaposed with the dispatch of messengers to Abimelech. Although less conventional than an explicit speech introduction, this is intelligible narrative quotation: the sender, recipient, message, and communicative function remain clear. Removing “说：” does not remove a distinct source-supported event.
  • Judges 9:30–33 · 看哪， (unit word) — Rejected: deleting “看哪，” removes an attention-getting discourse marker, not source-supported propositional content. The remaining report is natural and preserves its participants, events, and attribution.
  • Judges 9:30–33 · 现在， (unit word) — Rejected: “现在，” functions here as the transition “Now then,” introducing instructions whose actual timing remains explicitly “今晚”. Removing it leaves the same instructions and temporal content in natural Chinese.
  • Judges 9:30–33 · ，你就尽你所能对付他们 — 删除了尽其所能对付出战敌人的指令，确有来源支持的信息损失。但余下的“迦勒和他的人出来迎战时。”以“时”构成悬空的时间从句，没有后续主句；在所示陈述性指令语境中不能自然独立成句。
  • Judges 9:36–37 · 看哪， (unit phrase) — Removing “看哪” removes an attention-getting expression, not substantive information. The edited quotation naturally preserves the complete report that people are descending from the mountains.
  • Judges 9:36–37 · 你把山的影子看成人了。 — The substantive counterclaim is deleted. However, the exact remainder “西布勒却回答：“”” leaves a speech-introducing colon followed by an empty quotation. This is an incomplete presentation of a reply, not natural finished dialogue.
  • Judges 9:36–37 · 看哪， (unit phrase) — Removing “看哪，” removes an attention-getting discourse marker, not a distinct substantive instruction or event. Gaal's attribution and both reports of approaching people remain explicit, and the edited quotation is natural Chinese.
  • Judges 9:42–45 · 亚比米勒整天攻打那城， — The deletion removes Abimelech's day-long fighting against the city. However, the remaining sentence “直到把城攻下，杀了城中的百姓。” begins with an until-clause without a governing action. The preceding complete sentence about the other companies killing people in the fields does not naturally supply that missing construction. This is not merely an omitted-subject problem.
  • Judges 9:42–45 · 随后， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Judges 9:46–49 · 于是， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · 随后， — Removal only of a standalone marker is excluded by the explicit study rule.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · 城中所有的男女和首领都逃进那里， (ambiguous reference · possible other meaning changed) — The deletion removes the identification of the refugees and their flight into the tower. The remaining construction “城里有一座坚固的楼，把门锁上，登上楼顶” does not naturally establish a human subject for locking the door and climbing: its immediately introduced entity is the tower. The preceding human subject is Abimelech, not the city's refugees; carrying him forward would change who performs these actions.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · 这时， (distributed alignment · unit word) — Rejected. “这时” is a scene-linking temporal marker here. Without it, the same event remains situated in the ongoing tower attack, and no concrete participant, action, outcome, or substantive temporal condition disappears.
  • Judges 9:50–53 · 一个妇人把一块上磨石扔在亚比米勒的头上， (possible other meaning changed) — Rejected for fluency. The remaining “这时，砸碎了他的头骨” presents an active crushing predicate without a contextually recoverable agent or instrument. The preceding clause concerns Abimelech approaching to burn the tower and supplies neither a falling object nor someone striking him. Unlike ordinary Chinese subject ellipsis, this leaves an unsupported subject gap. 乌西雅有一支随时备战的军队，按编定的队伍出征。军队的编制由书记耶利和官员玛西雅登记，受王的一位官员哈拿尼雅指挥。 这些英勇战士的宗族首领共有二千六百人。 他们统领着三十万七千五百名训练有素的战士，是一支帮助王抵御仇敌的强大军队。 乌西雅为全军配备盾牌、长矛、头盔、铠甲、弓和投石带用的石头。 他又在耶路撒冷制造巧妙设计的器械，安置在城楼和城墙转角处，用来射箭和投掷大石。他的名声因此传遍远近，因为他得到极大的帮助，直到变得强盛。

26:16 · Accepted

但乌西雅强盛以后，便心高气傲，以致自取灭亡。他不忠于耶和华他的上帝，进入耶和华的殿，要在香坛上烧香。

Original · rejected

米迦问他：“你从哪里来？“我是利未人，从犹大的伯利恒来，正在寻找一个可以安居的地方。”

The explicit attribution of the answer to the visitor disappears. His identity as the intended respondent remains inferable from the exchange and subsequent verses, but is no longer explicitly stated here. The construction “米迦问他：“你从哪里来？“我是利未人” opens another quotation without closing the question or marking a speaker transition, so the exact result is not fluent. It also risks making the first-person declaration appear part of Micah’s speech rather than the visitor’s reply.

一个妇人把一块上磨石扔在亚比米勒的头上， · 19 characters

9:53 · Rejected

But a woman dropped an upper millstone on Abimelech’s head, crushing his skull.

这时，一个妇人把一块上磨石扔在亚比米勒的头上，砸碎了他的头骨。

After　这时，砸碎了他的头骨。

Rejected for fluency. The remaining “这时，砸碎了他的头骨” presents an active crushing predicate without a contextually recoverable agent or instrument. The preceding clause concerns Abimelech approaching to burn the tower and supplies neither a falling object nor someone striking him. Unlike ordinary Chinese subject ellipsis, this leaves an unsupported subject gap. Carrying forward Abimelech as the subject could also suggest that he crushed someone's skull, rather than that a woman's millstone crushed his.
